title: Maruti Suzuki's Q1 FY27: Navigating Headwinds Towards Growth
description: Maruti Suzuki's Q1 FY27 saw strong revenue and volume growth, but profitability was impacted by high input costs. Operating revenue surged 36% year-on-year to.

faq.q: Why did Maruti Suzuki's profit decline despite higher sales?
faq.a: Maruti Suzuki's net profit declined primarily due to a sharp increase in raw material and energy costs, exacerbated by geopolitical events. Additionally, the company shortened vendor payment terms to ensure supply continuity, absorbing these higher costs sooner.

faq.q: What caused the EBITDA margin to contract?
faq.a: The EBITDA margin contracted significantly from 12% to 8.2% mainly because of elevated material costs as a percentage of net sales, which surged by 600 basis points.

faq.q: Is the outlook for Maruti Suzuki still positive?
faq.a: Yes, management maintains a positive outlook for the full year, expecting a rebound. This is driven by recent price hikes, easing capacity constraints from new manufacturing plants, and continued strong demand for SUV models.

faq.q: How will new capacity additions impact the company?
faq.a: The commissioning of new plants and production lines, particularly at Kharkhoda and Hansalpur, adds approximately 500,000 units to Maruti Suzuki's annual capacity. This will help meet robust demand, reduce supply constraints, and support higher sales volumes.

faq.q: What is Maruti Suzuki doing about rising input costs?
faq.a: Maruti Suzuki has implemented price hikes to partially offset rising input costs. Additionally, by strategically supporting vendors through quicker settlements, it aims to maintain an uninterrupted supply chain while managing cost pressures.

faq.q: What is the company's strategy for alternative fuels?
faq.a: Maruti Suzuki has approved an initial investment of ₹561 crore for four compressed biogas (CBG) manufacturing projects and has also launched India's first flex-fuel car. This indicates a focus on diversifying its fuel offerings to meet evolving market and environmental needs.
